field_rule: Host build or CI success never equals actual-phone PASS. Promote only after install/open/safe mission evidence from the real phone.
play_protect_rule: Never ask the user to disable or bypass Play Protect. The previous Accessibility-based candidate remains frozen after actual-phone block evidence.
rollback_rule: Retain the last verified host baseline and reject any candidate that reintroduces sensitive permission, paid-credit dependency, false field PASS or weaker evidence boundary.
